author: reek
body: The unsound direction of scope-to-scope subsumption: a WIDER argument handed to a NARROWER parameter.

author: reek
body: `wide-read` may read anything under "/config/". `apply-deep` believes what it holds reads only under "/config/app/", and passes that belief to its own caller, who granted only "/config/app/". If this compiled, a scope would be a suggestion: the argument could read "/config/secrets.txt" while every signature in sight said it could not.

author: reek
body: `scope-subsumes` is asked with the PARAMETER's scope as the outer, so this is `text-starts-with "/config/" "/config/app/"`, which is False. The direction of that call is the whole safety property; reversing it here would launder every scope in the tree.
